summary: Module teardown guard-and-release. If the loaded-module handle hLibModule (0x008AFC78) is not set, returns 3 without acting. Otherwise invokes VFXClose (function pointer stored at 0x008AFC80), releases the library via FreeLibrary (IAT slot 0x0059E0C4), clears hLibModule, and returns 0. Called by HWInput_Exit (0x00455F00).

local_names.hLibModule: handle of the loaded VFX module (global 0x008AFC78)

operations.description: If hLibModule (0x008AFC78) is null, bail out early.
Return 3 when the module handle was never loaded.
Call the VFX close function through the pointer at 0x008AFC80.
Call FreeLibrary(hLibModule) through the import slot at 0x0059E0C4 to release the loaded module.
Clear hLibModule to 0 so a later unload is a no-op.
Return 0 on the successful unload path.

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the return code 3 (early-out) is unknown.
VFXClose at 0x008AFC80 is an indirect call target; the actual close routine is not identified here.
